name: Construction Robotics SAM
summary: Semi-automated bricklaying robot from the US maker Construction Robotics, no longer listed by the maker.

germany.statusNote: The maker's current product page and sitemap list only MULE lift-assist arms; SAM has no page any more, and no European sales route was ever found.

notes: Lifecycle set to discontinued because the maker no longer lists SAM; no maker statement on it was found.
No open source describes the SAM hardware any more (maker page removed), so drive type, arm and gripper are not confirmed; the drive flags are left false.
